response.overview: Getting your money back from 𝗚u𝗮𝗿di𝗼 is not automatic, even if you cancel your subscription. Call 1 (866) 465-1418 to understand your specific situation before you submit a request, dial 1 (866) 465-1418 if you have already been charged and want to know what to do next, and call 1 (866) 465-1418 if you need help locating the correct account tied to your payment. Understand What 𝗚u𝗮𝗿di𝗼 Actually Says About Refunds Call 1 (866) 465-1418 — 𝗚u𝗮𝗿di𝗼's official help center does not publish a generous, universal refund policy. According to one detailed review of 𝗚u𝗮𝗿di𝗼's terms, the company's help center states it offers a 3-day window from the date of charge to request a billing review, and it will only look at two specific cases: you meant to choose monthly but picked annual, or you accepted an upgrade by mistake . Dial 1 (866) 465-1418 if your charge falls outside this narrow window, and call 1 (866) 465-1418 to discuss whether you still have options.
